briefing: {PATRON} here, calling from the trade floor at {HERE}. One of my regulars is taking a Python out to the neighbour, loaded past good sense, and she wants a gun riding beside her the whole way.
Stay on her hull until she reads station range at the far end. Once she does, you are paid and she is someone else's worry.
Lose her out there and I lose a customer, so do not lose her.

cover.arrive: Ride shotgun on the Python until she reads station range at {TARGET}, then claim {PAY}
cover.success: The Python reached station range at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is yours
cover.fail: The Python never reached station range at {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.lead: {PATRON} wants a word next time the commander docks at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Word on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} is still short a gun for an escort run.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the Python still needs a gun riding beside her.

dossier.news: Traders at {WORLD} say {PATRON} is still looking for a gun to escort a Python out.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took a job at {WORLD} to escort a Python to a neighbour.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the Python sat safe at {WORLD}, and the job was done.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the escort had failed, and {WORLD} saw no more of that trade.

cover.success: The Python reached station range at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
cover.targetDestroyed: The Python was destroyed short of {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
cover.targetEscaped: The Python jumped away before reaching {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
cover.failed: The escort ran out of time before {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

dossier.title: Gun Beside Her
